R1.label: Toleranced dimension
R1.explain: A number with a plus/minus tolerance, like .500 ±.008.

R2.label: Limit dimension
R2.explain: An upper and a lower limit on one line, like 1.248-1.252.

R3.label: Size callout
R3.explain: A diameter, radius or thread callout with a number, like Ø.250 or M8.

R4.label: Feature control frame
R4.explain: A tolerance frame: a box with a tolerance value and datum letters.

R5.label: Numbered note
R5.explain: A numbered note that imposes a requirement, like 5. BREAK EDGES .010 MAX.

R6.label: Specification reference
R6.explain: A material or process specification is called out (AMS, ASTM, MIL, SAE, ISO).

R7.label: Surface finish
R7.explain: Looks like a surface finish value, like 63 Ra. Starts at Medium confidence.

R8.label: Ambiguous number
R8.explain: A number with no tolerance and no frame. It may be a requirement or a label, so the AI check is asked.

R9.label: Not used
R9.explain: Reserved. No check in this version produces R9.

R10.label: Label or prose
R10.explain: Mostly words, or no numbers, and no requirement pattern. Not a requirement.

R11.label: Short label
R11.explain: Under 3 characters, like a datum letter or an axis label. Not a requirement.

P1.label: Places shortfall
P1.explain: A callout says nX (for example 4X) but its BoC row records fewer places or results.

R4_frame_grid.label: Inside a tolerance frame
R4_frame_grid.explain: Sits in a detected frame of 3 or more cells and has a value, datum letters, or no text at all.

R1_tolerance.label: Plus/minus tolerance
R1_tolerance.explain: A number followed by a ± (or +/-) tolerance.

R4_frame_text.label: Frame text
R4_frame_text.explain: A tolerance value followed by 1 to 3 datum letters, as OCR reads a frame.

R2_limits.label: Limit pair
R2_limits.explain: Two decimal values joined by a dash.

R6_spec.label: Specification
R6_spec.explain: Names a standard: AMS, ASTM, MIL-, SAE or ISO.

R5_note.label: Numbered note
R5_note.explain: Starts like '5. TEXT' and has a value or a requirement word (BREAK, MAX, PER...).

R3_size.label: Size callout
R3_size.explain: A diameter, radius, spherical or thread symbol with a number.

R7_finish.label: Surface finish
R7_finish.explain: A 2-3 digit number followed by Ra, µ or MICRO.

R11_short.label: Too short
R11_short.explain: Fewer than 3 characters once spaces and symbols are folded.

R10_prose.label: Mostly words
R10_prose.explain: At least 4 letters and twice as many letters as digits, or a long run of capitals.

R8_has_digits.label: Numbers, no pattern
R8_has_digits.explain: Contains digits but matched none of the patterns above.

R10_fallback.label: No numbers, no pattern
R10_fallback.explain: Nothing above matched and there are no digits.

fired.label: Decided
fired.explain: The first check that matched. It decides the outcome.

matched_after.label: Also matched
matched_after.explain: Matched too, but an earlier check had already decided.

title_block.label: Title block
title_block.explain: Its centre is inside the title block zone of the sheet template.

border.label: Border and zone labels
border.explain: Its centre is in the border strip or a zone label margin of the sheet template.

revision_block.label: Revision block
revision_block.explain: Its centre is inside the revision block zone of the sheet template.

view_labels.label: View labels (SECTION A-A, DETAIL B)
view_labels.explain: Starts with SECTION, DETAIL or VIEW.

reference_dims.label: Reference dimensions (in parentheses)
reference_dims.explain: The whole text is in parentheses, which marks a reference dimension.

scale_notes.label: Scale notes
scale_notes.explain: Mentions SCALE, SHEET n OF n or VIEW ROTATED.

basic_dims.label: Basic dimensions (boxed numbers)
basic_dims.explain: A bare number inside a single box: a basic dimension, defined by a frame elsewhere.

custom_regex.label: Custom pattern
custom_regex.explain: Matched the extra regular expression set for this run.

location_gate.label: Near the row
location_gate.explain: At least half the text box lies inside the row's box (padded about 5 pt), or its centre does.

text_match.label: Text matches
text_match.explain: Values agree and the text is at least 60% similar to the row's requirement.

tight_overlap.label: Tight overlap
tight_overlap.explain: Values agree, the text box is 90% inside the row's box and at least 40% similar.

blank_in_zone.label: Blank region in the row's box
blank_in_zone.explain: No text was read, and it sits inside the row's box.

blank_frame_gdt.label: Blank frame
blank_frame_gdt.explain: A tolerance frame with no readable text inside a GD&T row's box.

row_best_region.label: Row's best match
row_best_region.explain: The row covers the best region at its location even if OCR garbled the text (half inside, at least 30% similar).

relocated_by_text.label: Row placed by text
relocated_by_text.explain: The BoC row had no location, so it was placed on the region whose text matched best (score >= 80).

ocr.label: OCR
ocr.explain: Read by the OCR engine (detection, angle classification, recognition) on the upright sheet.

ocr_rotated.label: OCR, rotated pass
ocr_rotated.explain: Read by a second OCR pass on the sheet turned ±30°, for slanted callouts.

text_layer.label: PDF text
text_layer.explain: Taken from the PDF's own text layer.

fcf_grid.label: Frame detector
fcf_grid.explain: A tolerance frame found by shape (a row of small boxes), even with no readable text.

covered.label: Covered
covered.explain: A BoC row accounts for this text.

excluded.label: Excluded
excluded.explain: Hidden by an exclusion (title block, labels, reference dimensions...).

not_requirement.label: Not a requirement
not_requirement.explain: A rule decided this text is a label or prose.

dropped_by_model.label: Dropped by AI
dropped_by_model.explain: Ambiguous, and the AI check said it is not a requirement.

covered_by_investigator.label: Linked by AI, check
covered_by_investigator.explain: Ambiguous; the AI investigator found a BoC row that already states it, and the row's text and values matched. Not flagged.

below_threshold.label: Below threshold
below_threshold.explain: Looked like a requirement but scored under 0.5, so it was not flagged.

merged.label: Merged
merged.explain: Overlaps a stronger flag, so it is shown as part of that flag.

flagged_unaccounted.label: Flagged: no row
flagged_unaccounted.explain: A requirement no BoC row covers (a U flag).

flagged_places.label: Flagged: places
flagged_places.explain: Covered, but the callout's nX count is more than the row records (a P flag).

base.label: Rule strength
base.explain: 0.9 for a clear pattern, 0.6 for a surface finish or an ambiguous number.

locate_factor.label: Location certainty
locate_factor.explain: 1.0 when BoC rows carry locations; 0.8 when the BoC has none or the nearest row was placed by text.

llm_factor.label: AI check
llm_factor.explain: 1.0 / 0.75 / 0.5 for high / medium / low AI certainty; 0.85 when the AI check did not run; 1.0 when a rule decided.

verdict.label: Answered
verdict.explain: The AI returned a verdict for this crop.

no_verdict.label: No answer
no_verdict.explain: The request was sent but no verdict came back for this crop.

not_sent.label: Not sent
not_sent.explain: The AI check did not run for this crop.

zoom.label: Zoomed in
zoom.explain: Looked at a sharper, larger view of the same region.

nearby_rows.label: Looked up nearby BoC rows
nearby_rows.explain: Listed the BoC rows located near the region.

ocr_context.label: Read the text around it
ocr_context.explain: Listed the OCR text next to the region.

search_boc.label: Searched the BoC
search_boc.explain: Searched every BoC row's requirement text.

investigate.label: Investigation
investigate.explain: Ambiguous leftovers: the AI may call a few read-only tools (zoom, nearby rows, nearby text, BoC search) before its verdict. Capped steps, tokens and time.

classify.label: Is it a requirement?
classify.explain: Ambiguous leftovers only. The answer can drop a candidate.

transcribe.label: Transcription
transcribe.explain: Reads the text of raised flags with proper symbols. Display only, never decides.

disabled.label: Off
disabled.explain: The AI check was turned off for this run.

no_credential.label: No key
no_credential.explain: No API key was set for the provider.

permission_denied.label: Not allowed
permission_denied.explain: The key can't use this model.

model_not_found.label: Unknown model
model_not_found.explain: The model was not found for this key.

rate_limited.label: Rate limited
rate_limited.explain: The API rate limited the request.

connection_failed.label: No connection
connection_failed.explain: The API could not be reached.

api_error.label: API error
api_error.explain: The API returned an error (api_error_<status> carries the HTTP status).

measured.label: Measured
measured.explain: Something read or measured from the drawing or the BoC.

parse_boc.label: Reading the BoC
parse_boc.explain: Parse and validate the Bill of Characteristics.

render.label: Rendering sheets
render.explain: Turn each sheet into an image.

ocr.label: Reading text
ocr.explain: OCR, PDF text and frame detection on each sheet.

match.label: Matching to BoC rows
match.explain: Decide which text each row covers.

rules.label: Classifying leftovers
rules.explain: Run rules R1-R11 on text no row covers.

model_check.label: AI check
model_check.explain: Ask the vision model about ambiguous leftovers.

places.label: Checking repeated features
places.explain: Compare nX callouts with the row's places.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.explain: Turn each candidate into a scored flag or drop it.

transcription.label: Transcribing flags
transcription.explain: AI transcription of flagged text, display only.
